remarks:
Welcome to the heart of Ellicottville! Whether you're looking for a turnkey investment property or the perfect mountain getaway, this fully furnished condo checks every box. Currently operating as a well-established short-term rental while also enjoyed for personal use, this property generated approximately $25,000 in net income in 2024 and $21,000 in net income in 2025, making it an excellent addition to any investment portfolio. Ideally located just 0.8 miles from the Village of Ellicottville, you'll enjoy easy access to charming shops, restaurants, breweries, festivals, and year-round entertainment. Plus, you're within walking distance to Holiday Valley Resort, offering incredible convenience for skiing, snowboarding, golf, mountain biking, and more. Inside, you'll find a bright, updated, and completely turnkey space. The fully stocked kitchen features brand-new appliances, including the refrigerator, oven, and dishwasher. The open-concept living and dining area is designed to maximize space with a cozy gas fireplace, built-in vanity, and a Murphy bed for sleeping accommodations. Step through the sliding glass doors onto the patio and take in picturesque slope views—perfect for enjoying your morning coffee or relaxing after a day on the mountain.
With numerous updates, furnishings included, and a proven rental history, this low-maintenance condo is ready for its next owner to enjoy from day one. Whether you're seeking a personal retreat, a profitable vacation rental, or the best of both worlds, this is a rare opportunity to own in one of Western New York's premier four-season destinations.
